_comment: The ayat of the lessons' example clips OUTSIDE the lessons (content/compose/<slug>.json `examples`: the imam's voice of a bentuk dasar, played when its `base` frame is on the lesson stage), exactly as the pinned files have them: `tanzil` = the Tanzil Uthmani line, `segments` and `stats` = the quran-align Alafasy_128kbps entry. pipeline/cache is git-ignored, so without this file CI could not tell a shifted timing or a wrong word in these clips. Written by build_compose.py (compose.examples_fixture); validate_compose.py checks it against the pinned files when the cache is present, and the clips against it in every run. Never edit by hand.

5:23.tanzil: قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَٰلِبُونَ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

6:126.tanzil: وَهَٰذَا صِرَٰطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

41:9.tanzil: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

55:78.tanzil: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
